newsitem.title: USA: NationsBanc hires DLJ's Weiner as junk analyst.
newsitem.headline: NationsBanc hires DLJ's Weiner as junk analyst.

text.p: NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc has hired Michael Weiner, formerly a high-yield analyst at Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, to run its high-yield media and telecommunications research effort, according to Thomas White, managing director and head of the high-yield department at NationsBanc.
"We have a signficant commitment to the high-yield business and media and telcommunications is an area where we have an important role to play," said White.

Weiner will oversee a two person staff consisting of Jacob Barker and another senior media analyst who has yet to be hired, said White. Barker was the only analyst covering the media and telecommunications sector prior to Weiner's arrival.
In his new position, Weiner will report to Raymond Stotlemyer, director of high-yield research at NationsBanc.

At DLJ, Weiner served as a high-yield media and telecommunications analyst, reporting to Roger Gordon, head of high-yield research. A DLJ spokeswoman would not immediately comment as to whether a replacement for him had been found.
Seperately, Glori Holzman, formerly the co-director of high-yield research and oil and gas analyst at NationsBanc resigned roughly two weeks ago.
White said the firm is currently looking for another individual to replace Holzman in her role as oil and gas analyst.
He said Stotlemyer will serve as the sole head of high-yield research at NationsBanc going forward.
Kelly Krenger, a junior analyst at NationsBanc, will temporarily cover the oil and gas sector until a replacement for Holzman is found, White said.
NationsBanc is the investment banking subsidiary of NationsBank Corp.
